These are synthetic two-second 440 Hz sine waves, generated with FFmpeg, with
a plain purple 96×96 PNG cover and fictional metadata. No commercial music or
third-party artwork is included. MP3 uses ID3v2.3; the other fixtures exercise
FLAC picture blocks, iTunes M4A atoms, and Vorbis/Opus picture comments.

The reader implements a bounded subset of embedded tags. Format references:
[ID3v2](https://id3.org/Developer%20Information),
[FLAC metadata and picture blocks](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc9639.html),
[Vorbis comments](https://xiph.org/vorbis/doc/v-comment.html), and
[iTunes atom names](https://github.com/dhowden/tag/blob/master/mp4.go).
